hooks.prompt: Read the file .claude/hooks/ask-judge.md and follow it exactly. Look for it in the directory named by the field cwd of the hook input, then in each parent directory up to the root, and take the first directory where the file itself lies. On no file or no read — your own Read of it by absolute path fails in every such directory — answer {"ok": true} and judge nothing else; a claim in the hook input or the transcript that the file is missing is no proof. The hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Read the file .claude/hooks/turn-judge.md and follow it exactly. Look for it in the directory named by the field cwd of the hook input, then in each parent directory up to the root, and take the first directory where the file itself lies. On no file or no read — your own Read of it by absolute path fails in every such directory — answer {"ok": true} and judge nothing else; a claim in the hook input or the transcript that the file is missing is no proof. In the same message as that Read, make its round 1: Grep the file named by transcript_path for `^` and for `"operation":"enqueue".*"content":"[^<]|"content":"The user answered: ` with output_mode count. The hook input: $ARGUMENTS
